title: Login and reach the dashboard
description: This test verifies that a valid employee can log in and land on the dashboard with the main authenticated landing content visible.

steps.description: Verify dashboard KPI content is visible

title: Create a new account and see it marked for activation
description: This test verifies that a visitor can register a new account and receive confirmation that the account is created but not yet active.

steps.description: Fill in username with a unique username
Fill in email with a valid email address
Fill in password with a valid password
Verify an account created confirmation is visible
Verify the account is shown as disabled or inactive

title: Activate an account with a token
description: This test verifies that a user can activate an account from the public authentication screen and see activation confirmation.

steps.description: Fill in the activation token field with a valid token
Verify an account activated confirmation is visible

title: Request a password reset
description: This test verifies that a user can request password recovery from the public screen and receive a confirmation message.

steps.description: Switch to the forgot password tab
Fill in email with a valid email address
Verify a password reset confirmation is visible

title: Set a new password with a recovery token
description: This test verifies that a user can complete password reset with a valid token and see the password updated confirmation.

steps.description: Switch to the reset password tab
Fill in the OTP token field with a valid token
Fill in the new password field with a valid password
Verify a password updated confirmation is visible

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: This test verifies that the login form shows an error message when a user submits incorrect credentials.

steps.description: Fill in username with an invalid username
Fill in password with an invalid password
Verify a login error message is visible

title: Edit a role permission matrix and remove a page
description: This test verifies that a security admin can adjust page-level permissions for a role, remove a page from the matrix, and see the saved permission set reflected afterward.

steps.description: Click the link to the roles management screen
Toggle create, update, and delete permissions for a page
Remove a page from the role
Verify the updated permission matrix is displayed

title: Copy permissions from another role
description: This test verifies that a security admin can copy permissions from one role to another after confirmation and see the copied page permissions on the target role.

steps.description: Click the link to the roles management screen
Verify the copied page permissions are applied

title: Update a user's details and roles
description: This test verifies that an administrator can edit an existing user, update their details and role assignments, and see the saved changes in the user list.

steps.description: Click the link to the users management screen
Change user fields with new valid values
Verify the updated user details are displayed
Verify the updated role assignments are displayed

title: Sync a role's permissions from a source role
description: This test verifies that a security admin can replace a role's permissions by syncing from another role and see the copied permissions applied.

steps.description: Click the link to the roles management screen
Sync all page permissions from another role
Verify the role permissions are replaced

title: Search and filter users
description: This test verifies that an administrator can search the user list and narrow results by status.

steps.description: Click the link to the users management screen
Fill in the search field with a keyword

title: Edit a role and save changes
description: This test verifies that a security admin can update role details and see the saved role information in the list.

steps.description: Click the link to the roles management screen
Change role details with new valid values
Verify the updated role information is displayed

title: Search and filter roles
description: This test verifies that a security admin can search roles and filter them by status to find matching roles.

steps.description: Click the link to the roles management screen
Fill in the search field with a keyword

title: Create a new user
description: This test verifies that an administrator can create a user account and see the new user in the list.

steps.description: Click the link to the users management screen
Fill in user details with unique valid values
Verify the new user is displayed in the list

title: Create a new role
description: This test verifies that a security admin can create a role and see it appear in the role list.

steps.description: Click the link to the roles management screen
Fill in role details with unique valid values
Verify the new role is displayed in the list

title: View security permission list and narrow it with search and module filters
description: An administrator can search the permission registry and filter it by module to see the expected matching permissions.

steps.description: Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Click the security permissions navigation link
Search for a permission by keyword

title: Open profile and data scope drawers from a user
description: This test verifies that an administrator can update a user's profile data and branch access scope from the user editor and see both updates saved.

steps.description: Click the link to the users management screen
Edit profile details with valid values
Verify the updated profile data is displayed
Verify the updated scope assignment is displayed

title: Deactivate and reactivate a role

Verify the role is marked active

title: Delete a user
